name: The Vault Radio
summary: An unlockable station tied to The Vault nightclub in Vice City, added to the radio list by scanning a poster inside the club.
body: PowerPyx says a single red poster just past the entrance of The Vault nightclub in Downtown Vice City unlocks it, after which it appears under Radio as The Vault.
The Big Lead describes it as a secret electronic and rave station that plays the music heard inside the club, unlocked by scanning a poster showing a pink gas mask with the phone.
PowerPyx counts it as one of two Unique Playlists required for full completion.

GameSpot confirms the unlock: scan the poster with a pink gas mask inside The Vault nightclub, near the middle of Vice City, and the station then plays the dance and electronic tracks heard in the club.
Consequence's list of hosts taken from the game's credits gives The Vault Radio's host as DJ Pretzel, appearing as himself.

name: The Sniper of La Perle
summary: An unlockable on-demand playlist earned by scanning four posters around La Perle and Crosstown in Vice City.
body: PowerPyx places the four posters at Aunt Zola's Soul Food, TWA Ponya Tattoo and the Drip Drops clothing store in La Perle, and in a recording booth at the Jack of Hearts club in Crosstown.
PowerPyx says it is then played from a car radio or headphones under the On Demand menu, and that it is one of two Unique Playlists needed for full completion.
The guide does not say what the playlist contains.

name: On Demand audio and podcasts
summary: Besides live radio, the game has an On Demand menu for podcasts and unlocked playlists, usable in vehicles and through headphones.
body: Rockstar's music page says the game's audio runs from classic rock to talk radio and includes podcasts, but it names no podcast.
PowerPyx reports that both the Radio and On Demand menus can be used from a car radio or from headphones.
No source read for this research named an individual podcast or its host.
As of launch day, none of the radio guides read (GameSpot, CULTR, The Big Lead) names an individual podcast or its host, and Rockstar has not listed any.
